exact_representation_argument: Integer BFS enumerates exactly every reachable original vertex; port rows retain exactly reachable ports other than root, matching stock DiGraph.simplify.
A row bit i means exactly one dependency on port i.64-bit chunk factors are keyed by both chunk index and complete bit pattern, per instance.
Each original dependency edge becomes source->factor->destination. Sharing a factor only for the identical destination subset cannot add or remove paths between real nodes.
Every factored cycle projects to an original cycle and every original cycle expands to a factored cycle. Virtual nodes are never written into the circuit.
Analysis API expands factored instance edges; source paths and full graph edges are compared with unmodified stock analysis in the regression.
source_scope: Only private CheckCombLoops analysis representation; original circuit statement extraction, SCC, memory/ExtModule handling and error-trigger retained.

validation.proof_scope: Source argument and finite compiler regression; not full host or hardware equivalence
